prompt:
Create a 30-second cinematic 3D adventure short film featuring a young Korean woman exploring a remote, untouched jungle river in South Korea.
Visual style: Ultra-detailed cinematic 3D animation with realistic environments, natural skin and hair, believable water physics, realistic vegetation, atmospheric lighting, subtle film grain, detailed textures, and premium adventure-film quality. The woman should remain visually identical throughout the entire video. No cartoonish appearance, no plastic skin, no fantasy creatures, no excessive CGI.

[0:00–0:05] — INTO THE JUNGLE

Open with a wide cinematic aerial shot of a dense Korean mountain forest after light rain.

A young Korean woman wearing a practical outdoor adventure outfit, hiking boots, a small backpack, and a waterproof jacket walks through thick vegetation.

She hears the sound of rushing water and looks toward the trees.

Slowly follow her from behind as she discovers a narrow river hidden deep inside the forest.

[0:05–0:11] — THE RIVER

She reaches the riverbank.

Crystal-clear water flows between large moss-covered rocks, surrounded by dense green vegetation and tall trees.

She carefully steps into the shallow water and begins walking upstream.

Use low-angle water-level shots showing her boots entering the flowing water, followed by smooth tracking shots beside her.

Keep the water movement physically realistic.

[0:11–0:18] — THE CANYON

The river becomes narrower as she continues.

She enters a spectacular natural canyon surrounded by enormous rock walls covered with moss and small plants.

Sunlight breaks through the trees above, creating natural beams of light across the water.

She notices a small opening behind a waterfall and approaches it carefully.

[0:18–0:24] — THE HIDDEN CAVE

She moves behind the waterfall and discovers a hidden natural cave.

Inside, the walls are covered with beautiful mineral textures and tiny droplets of water.

She shines her flashlight around the cave and discovers an underground stream continuing deeper into the mountain.

Her expression changes from curiosity to amazement.

[0:24–0:30] — THE REVEAL

She follows the underground stream toward the cave entrance.

Suddenly, the camera moves past her and reveals a breathtaking hidden valley on the other side.

A larger river flows through the valley, surrounded by untouched Korean mountains and mist.

She stands silently at the entrance, looking at the landscape.

End with a slow cinematic pull-back revealing the woman as a tiny figure surrounded by the enormous natural landscape.

CONSISTENCY & QUALITY CONTROL

Maintain exactly the same woman, face, hairstyle, clothing, backpack, body proportions, and accessories throughout every shot.

Maintain consistent geography and spatial relationships between the jungle, river, canyon, waterfall, cave, and valley.

No character morphing, identity changes, duplicated characters, extra limbs, distorted hands, warped face, disappearing objects, floating objects, texture flickering, water glitches, unnatural physics, sudden lighting changes, camera jumps, frame interpolation artifacts, or temporal instability.

Use simple, physically believable actions and smooth camera transitions.

Camera: Cinematic aerial shots, stabilized tracking shots, water-level shots, macro environmental details, smooth dolly movement, natural depth of field.

Lighting: Soft overcast jungle light transitioning into warm sunlight and subtle atmospheric rays.

Mood: Mysterious, adventurous, peaceful, awe-inspiring.

Duration: 30 seconds
Aspect ratio: 16:9
Quality: Premium cinematic 3D animation, highly realistic environment and physics.

translations.zh: 创作一部30秒的电影级3D冒险短片，展现一名年轻韩国女性探索韩国偏远原始丛林河流。视觉风格为写实超精细3D动画，分为五个分镜段落：丛林鸟瞰与穿行、溯溪而上、狭窄峡谷与光束、瀑布后的矿物洞穴与手电筒探险、洞口眺望壮丽迷雾河谷及大远景拉出。
translations.en: Create a 30-second cinematic 3D adventure short film featuring a young Korean woman exploring a remote jungle river in South Korea. Features realistic 3D animation across five structured shot sequences from the dense forest to river wading, canyon, hidden cave, and a final valley reveal with a pull-back shot.
